howtos.title: Strip agent code comments with /no-comments
howtos.what: poteto's tip: run the /no-comments skill from pstack, or turn it into a lint rule, to cut noisy agent comments.
copy: Or ask your agent to turn it into a lint rule.
howtos.whenToUse: When coding agents keep filling your codebase with comments that add nothing.

howtos.title: Batch several branches into one PR for CI
howtos.what: Kun Chen batches multiple branches into one PR; his PRs fell from about 200 to 30 a day while he ships more.
copy: Batch multiple branches into one PR instead of opening one PR per branch, to make CI more efficient.
howtos.whenToUse: When agent-driven PR volume is clogging your CI pipeline.
